name: tiny-fix
about: A one-line bug fix in one file: the team's tiny lane against a plain session.
goal: count_words in wordcount.py gives the wrong number when words are separated by more than one space, by tabs or by newlines, and it should return 0 for an empty or all-whitespace text. Fix it and add a test for those cases.

criteria.text: WHEN words are separated by repeated spaces, tabs or newlines THEN count_words counts each word once
criteria.check: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from wordcount import count_words as c; assert c('a  b\tc\nd') == 4 and c('  a b  ') == 2"

criteria.text: WHEN the text is empty or only whitespace THEN count_words returns 0
criteria.check: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from wordcount import count_words as c; assert c('') == 0 and c(' \t\n ') == 0"

criteria.text: WHEN the test suite runs THEN it passes
WHEN the fix is done THEN a test covers the new cases
